name: Ark Vision AI Widget
author: Ark Solutions

sections.description:
The Ark Vision AI Widget plugin lets you add your AI-powered customer service chat widget to every page of your WordPress site automatically. Simply paste your Widget Token from your Ark Vision dashboard and the widget is live instantly — no coding required.

This plugin connects to the Ark Vision service (arkvision.arksolutionsglobal.com). Chat data including visitor messages, name, and email are transmitted to Ark Vision’s servers. By using this plugin you agree to the Ark Vision Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Go to Settings → Ark Vision Widget
  3. Paste your Widget Token from your Ark Vision Dashboard → Widget
  4. Save — your widget is live on every page
sections.faq:
Do I need an Ark Vision account?

Yes. Sign up at arkvision.arksolutionsglobal.com to get your Widget Token.

Where do I find my Widget Token?

In your Ark Vision Dashboard under Settings → Widget.

Does the widget collect visitor data?

Yes — visitor name, email, and chat messages are sent to Ark Vision’s servers to power the AI chat. See our Privacy Policy for details.
